name: museum-capture
description: Schema-driven artefact cataloguing for museum volunteers

scripts.db:seed: node scripts/seed-schema.mjs && wrangler d1 execute artefact-catalogue --remote --file=migrations/seed-schema.sql
scripts.db:check: wrangler d1 execute artefact-catalogue --remote --command "SELECT version, field_count, state FROM schema_health"
scripts.db:errors: wrangler d1 execute artefact-catalogue --remote --command "SELECT at, device_id, stage, message FROM sync_errors ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT 20"
scripts.db:records: wrangler d1 execute artefact-catalogue --remote --command "SELECT registration_number, object_name, status, captured_by, updated_at FROM current_records ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 20"
